audit.why: Burst-vs-sustain even matchup at every stage per content and packet — Starcall heal offsets his chip and Wish answers his burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit despite being the numbers field.
audit.why: Sear (Q) is 8s early down to 6s at rank 5 and only stuns an ablaze target; Pillar of Flame (W) sits at 10s; Pyroclasm (R) is 100/90/80s and bounces to stack Blaze on champions.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers for Q/W/R.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 full-layer phases[N].side said Brand while all 7 content win[N] said Skill — a total disagreement, further contradicted by the packet's own levelChart (all Skill).
audit.why: Content's whys correctly describe a burst-vs-heal push-pull that stays even at every stage; the full layer's side column and whys were describing an unrelated battery-economy narrative that doesn't fit Brand's kit (no engage to bank around).
audit.corrected: Flipped all 7 phases[N].side to Skill to match win[N], and rewrote each .why to state the burst-vs-sustain balance instead of the generic template.

edits.before: Starcall the contacts — the self-heal funds the bank and the slow annoys their spacing.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: his Q Sear is dodgeable and your Starcall heal offsets his chip.

edits.before: W opens the battery: your carry's HP bar is now a shared account.
edits.after: Skill-based: his stun-into-Pillar threat weighs against your sustain.

edits.before: Equinox threats begin: the silence zone cancels engages mid-cast.
edits.after: Level 3 stays even as your heals keep pace with his poke damage.

edits.before: Heal the margins and Q the refills — the battery economy runs the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay balanced while both scale their damage and sustain.

edits.before: Wish online — every all-in on the map gets a second health bar.
edits.after: At 6, Pyroclasm burst is matched by your Wish and heal refills.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the silence zones decide dives.
edits.after: First item: his burst spike and your sustain roughly cancel out.

edits.before: Late Soraka is the global bank: wish the map, silence the dives, and outlast every ledger.
edits.after: Late, your team-wide healing directly counters his sustained magic burst, keeping it even.

edits.before: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies.
edits.after: Sear (Q) only stuns an ablaze target — watch his passive stacks, not the cast, to call the dodge.

edits.before: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: Standing in a Pillar of Flame zone while topping off — the splash damage outpaces one heal tick.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. It writes your spacing rules. - E Equinox is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Sear (Q) is 8s early, 6s at rank 5, and only stuns an ablaze target — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge, it writes your spacing. - Pillar of Flame (W) sits at 10s. - Pyroclasm (R) is 100/90/80s, bounces to max Blaze.

notes: Same defect pattern as blitzcrank: the full-layer chart said Brand won every stage while content and the packet both said Skill (even) at every stage — fixed by flipping all 7 sides and rewriting the whys to match the burst-vs-sustain dynamic. missingInteractions was empty for this matchup. diff/diffRating/carryRating (HARD/8/8.5) left untouched — not contradicted by the win-rate/chart fix, and reflect how punishing a landed combo is, not lane win rate.
